youtube.title: PAUL HENRY
youtube.summary: Peter Williams speaks with ACT Party list candidate Paul Henry about the party’s fiscal plan, including raising the superannuation age to 67 from 2035, making KiwiSaver investment returns tax-free, and tightening eligibility for disability benefits. They discuss the savings ACT says it can achieve, proposed public service cuts and the challenge of negotiating these policies with potential coalition partners. youtube.title: GLEN DAVIES & CARYN ZINN
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan is joined by Dr Glen Davies and Caryn Zinn to talk about the upcoming Metabolic Health New Zealand Summit. They discuss why metabolic health could be key to tackling New Zealand’s healthcare crisis and argue for greater focus on prevention and the root causes of chronic disease, alongside better food choices, exercise and multidisciplinary care. For more on The Metabolic Health NZ Summit 2026 | 13–14 November, Auckland Discover more from Metabolic Health NZ

youtube.title: GARY MOLLER
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan talks with health practitioner Gary Moller about hidden sources of aluminium exposure, from deodorants and fertiliser to childhood vaccines and how hair tissue mineral analysis can flag toxic build-up. Gary also introduces his apolitical Free Rangers movement, arguing New Zealand's politicians should be judged by whether their policies make the country the best place to live and raise a family. For further information: Check out some of Gary's articles: When Small Bodies Face Big Toxic Challenges: A Question of Dose, Timing, and Vulnerability Minerals: Aluminium's Toxic Effects on Human Health Aluminium – It's Harming People!
